roster_grade.headline: 4-0 contender — hold the vets, and spend QB3 Shough on a young RB
roster_grade.window_explanation: #1 by record and #2 in points for, but only #7 by roster value — you're winning on production and a strong lineup, not depth. That's a win-now profile: protect the lineup, upgrade the one aging position.

strengths.label: Winning now
strengths.detail: 4-0 with 309 points for (#2 in the league). The lineup is producing every week.

strengths.label: Superflex QB
strengths.detail: Mahomes starts; Bo Nix and Tyler Shough give you a third starting-caliber QB to trade — rare in a 2-QB league.

strengths.label: Four quality WRs
strengths.detail: Smith, Parker Washington, Watson, and Higgins fill all four WR slots.

strengths.label: Loveland + a premium pick
strengths.detail: Elite young TE1, plus Bijan Mustard's 2028 1st — they're 0-4, so it's trending toward the top of the draft.

weaknesses.label: Every starting RB is aging
weaknesses.detail: Henry (32), Javonte (26), and Hubbard (27) are all past their peak. They're fine this year, but it's the one spot to reinforce.

weaknesses.label: Thin behind the starters
weaknesses.detail: Your 5th WR (Malik Washington) and 4th RB (Harvey) are well behind — one injury exposes it.

weaknesses.label: Value lags the record
weaknesses.detail: #7 by roster value. Some regression is likely unless you add talent.

roster_grade.most_urgent_action: Turn Tyler Shough into a young RB. Three 0-4 sellers need a QB. Cleanest deals: Shough + RJ Harvey for Jeremiyah Love (Lemon Party), or Shough straight up for Breece Hall (Bijan Mustard). Keep Henry and every starting WR — you're 4-0.

QB.commentary: Mahomes plus two tradeable starters. Shough is the chip.

RB.commentary: Starters hold up against the league today, but all three are aging. The upgrade target.

WR.commentary: Exactly four quality starters for four slots — solid, but no spare.

TE.commentary: Loveland is elite; Hockenson is a luxury TE2.

trade_priority_order: Shough → a young RB from a 0-4 seller (Love from Lemon Party, or Hall from Bijan Mustard)
Optional all-in: Shough + Javonte + Harvey + 2028 4th for Bijan Robinson
Hold Henry, Hubbard, and all four starting WRs — you're 4-0
If Loveland's healthy, flip Hockenson to a TE-needy seller for an RB (Kyren Williams)
Sell Kamara to an RB-needy contender for a late pick

sell_now.reason: QB3 in superflex, and three sellers need a QB. His value is highest before those teams find another answer.
Bench RB at 31 — his value only drops from here.
Surplus TE2 once Loveland starts; You Hate Us and Phil's are weak at TE.

buy_now.reason: 0-4 and weak at QB and RB — Shough + Harvey solves both for them.
0-4 and weak at QB. Simplest deal on the board.
The all-in. Mahomes, Henry, and Nix all stay.
buy_now.offer: Tyler Shough + Javonte Williams + RJ Harvey + 2028 4th

buy_now.from_team: You Hate Us Cuz You Anus
buy_now.reason: Selling, and weak at TE and WR.

do_not_trade: Derrick Henry — producing starter on a 4-0 team
DeVonta Smith / Parker Washington / Christian Watson / Tee Higgins — your only four quality WRs
trade_strategy.pick_strategy: Picks are currency for a 4-0 team — package mid- and late-rounders. Hold Bijan Mustard's 2028 1st (they're 0-4, so it's trending top-3) and your own 2027 1st.

outlook.projected_power_rank: Title contender — #1 by record, #2 in points, #2 in title odds.
outlook.three_year_outlook: Win now on the Mahomes/WR core. Adding a young RB this season also sets up 2027 as the vets age out.
outlook.season_narrative: The Jabroni Beaters are 4-0 and producing like a top team, even though the roster ranks #7 by value. The lineup is winning, so the job is to protect it and fix the one soft spot: an aging RB room. Three 0-4 teams (Bijan Mustard, Lemon Party, Un-Kirk Penix) need a QB, and you have Shough to spend.
key_risks: Regression — you're outscoring your roster value
An RB injury exposes thin depth
Waiting too long to use Shough while the sellers need a QB
key_upside_factors: Landing Love, Hall, or Bijan makes RB a strength
Stribling back from IR adds WR depth

teams_to_watch.why: 0-4 and weak at QB. Holds Bijan and Hall — Shough is the key.
0-4 and weak at QB and RB. Holds Jeremiyah Love.
3-1, #1 in value — your main title rival.
Contender that's weak at WR — a complementary trade partner.
